## Triage: first grade, `bug` · `priority:p2` · `domain:ui` · `area:identity` · `pm:queue` · triage seat · `session_01AavokzJ5DndAwitDXvKy4U` · 2026-10-16T15:02Z

Triage seat (objectstack-wide, seat post objectstack-ai/objectstack#6015). ⛔ Not a claim, ⛔ not a dispatch.

- **Why p2:** the login page of every SSO-enforced environment shows an "or continue with email" divider with nothing under it, on every load.
- **Lane:** `domain:ui`. Both fixes are in `packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx` and need no spec change, as the card says.

Claim: PM loop round 2
Session: `session_01Vk15bz8xHtKGUfXfCm16h4`
Account: `os-elon-musk` (the seat's linked user as `GET /user` answers it; the card's assignee)
Branch: `claude/issue-12682-sso-login-pending-copy`
Worktree: `objectui-issue-12682`
Domain: `domain:ui`
Seat: `domain:ui#3`
File surface: `packages/auth/src/LoginForm.tsx` (the header's description while `configPending`, and whether the provider block's divider shows while `passwordFormVisible` is false); `packages/auth/src/SocialSignInButtons.tsx` (one optional prop that omits its divider, with the default keeping today's rendering for `RegisterForm` and every other caller); `packages/auth/README.md` where it documents `SocialSignInButtons`' props; tests beside each; one `.changeset/12682-*.md` (stop on breach; explain in the report)
Container & model: `S`, `mode:subagent`, `model: opus` (default tier; `dispatch-gates --tier --repo objectstack-ai/objectui` over the named paths: no path-derived mandate)
Clause-②: yes
Clause-② reason: `@object-ui/auth` exports `SocialSignInButtons` and `SocialSignInButtonsProps` (`packages/auth/src/index.ts:38`), and the divider can be withheld only by a new optional member of that props type. That is a widening of a published UI surface, with no `@object-ui/types` member and no authoring key. The dev reads the final name on the built `dist/index.d.ts`. The seat's `TIER_DEFAULT` review of record comes before ready.
Responsibility: `@object-ui/auth`'s `LoginForm` captions the config-pending spinner with the password form's description, and `SocialSignInButtons` always draws its "or continue with email" divider, including under SSO enforcement where no email form follows | none covers it | every user of an SSO-enforced environment's login page, on every load (measured 3/3 on a live boot by QA, objectstack-ai/objectstack#23943; the lines the card names stand on `main` `1d86919`: `LoginForm.tsx:201`, `:246`, `:260`, `:441`, `:456`; `SocialSignInButtons.tsx:122`, `:211`)
Thread-read: 6218331213
Serial constraints cleared: objectui#12712 (`pm:queue` + `pm:retriage`, no PR, the same `LoginForm.tsx`, field region only if triage re-scopes it) is serial, not fold, by gate ①: a different defect shape. Whichever lands second merges `main`. objectui#12700 (`baozhoutao`) may touch `packages/auth/src/` only where `/auth/me/permissions` loads, a different region. No other in-flight `domain:ui` claim and no open objectui PR names `packages/auth/`, read across the lane's `pm:dispatched` claims and all 8 open PRs' file lists 2026-10-16T18:08Z.
